Game text and DS item-reference data.
English labels and item ratings come from the game's reviewed
     tables and existing English wording. Supporting provenance:
     research/gameplay-reference-data.md
     Item descriptions identify intended uses, not tested cure rates.

Thanks to the Japanese guide authors and contributors whose work
helps make these routes accessible. English item and choice labels
follow the existing English patch where available. The accompanying
research notes retain the terminology evidence and source disputes.

Earlier IV books inspired the reference layouts, including character
profiles, port entries, and ship data. The official 2006 DS/PSP guide's
full text has not been accessed, so it is not cited for unseen facts.

This is an independent guide, not an official Koei publication.
English explanations are original. This text edition is source-based;
it does not claim a verified full DS playthrough. Source conflicts,
untested gates, and inaccessible material remain explicitly identified.
